slides.s: PMP-Certified Engineering Leader | 21 Years in Software, DevOps & AI-Driven Engineering Transformation
slides.n: Please welcome Mayur Saxena, a PMP-certified engineering leader with over two decades of experience building high-performing teams and delivering enterprise-scale software products. {His} recent work centers on driving Agentic AI transformation across engineering organizations.

items: F5 Innovation India · Jul2025-Sep2026 — Led a 10-member team on BIG-IP control plane services, reduced upgrade time by ~90%, drove security hardening, and built 7-8 AI agents for CVE remediation and bug resolution.

Cisco Systems India · Mar2020-Jul2025 — Led Webex developer experience team, architected distributed presence/calling integration between Webex and Microsoft Teams using Kafka, Redis, and Java, and drove AI-based code generation for Webex SDKs.

Cisco Systems India · Apr2018-Feb2020 — Led developers, testers and release engineers on Cisco Expressway, driving Python/C++ platform features, Erlang-based DB upgrades, and DevOps release infrastructure.

Cisco Systems India · Apr2008-Feb2018 — Owned functional, regression and automation testing for Cisco Call Manager and Expressway, handled customer escalations, and drove automation coverage toward 100%.
Verizon India · May2007-Mar2008 — Performed end-to-end call-flow testing and bug verification for IP-converged contact center solutions including IVR and prepaid dialing.
slides.n: {His} journey spans 21 years, moving from hands-on QA and protocol testing roles into team leadership and, ultimately, engineering management. Along the way {he} built distributed systems, led AI transformation initiatives, and consistently improved product reliability and delivery speed.

Mayur brings a broad technical skill set, from deep VoIP protocol expertise built over years of QA and platform work, to modern cloud, DevOps, and Agentic AI capabilities that {he} now applies to accelerate engineering delivery.

These numbers reflect the tangible impact of {his} leadership — from dramatically cutting upgrade times to resolving over a hundred long-standing defects and CVEs, and building a suite of AI agents to automate engineering workflows.

Mayur's foundation includes a B.E. in Electronic and Communication, PMP certification for project leadership, and a more recent postgraduate program in Artificial Intelligence from the University of Texas at Austin, reflecting {his} continued growth into AI-driven engineering.

slides.s: Let's connect on driving AI-enabled engineering transformation together
slides.n: Thank you for learning about Mayur Saxena's journey — a career built on technical depth, engineering leadership, and a forward-looking embrace of AI to transform how software teams deliver value.
